caption: A kettle on a stove is at the boil, steam pours from the spout, and the lid rattles.

sa.check: A kettle sits on a stove.
Steam comes out of the spout.
The lid rattles: a small repeated movement on its seat.
The kettle is a stovetop kettle with a spout and a lid.
The burner or stove is visible under the kettle.

pc.expect: Steam leaves the spout and rises, spreading and thinning as it goes up.
pc.fail: Steam sinks toward the stove or pools on the counter; or stays as a dense cloud that does not thin; or streams straight sideways with no draught visible.

pc.expect: The steam keeps coming and the plume moves outward from the spout; puffs that have left keep moving away.
pc.fail: The plume runs back into the spout; or a puff retreats toward the kettle; or steam appears in the air far from the spout and drifts toward it.

pc.expect: The lid's rattle goes with the boil: it lifts and drops on its seat while steam issues, and steam may puff from under it.
pc.fail: The lid moves with no steam anywhere; or the lid lifts and stays up; or the lid rattles while the kettle is off the stove.

pc.expect: The kettle itself stays put on the burner; only the lid and the steam move.
pc.fail: The kettle slides, rocks or turns on the burner with nothing touching it; or the spout swings.

pc.expect: One kettle with one lid and one spout; the lid stays attached and nothing passes through the kettle body.
pc.fail: A second spout or lid appears; or the lid passes through the kettle wall; or the kettle changes shape or vanishes; or steam comes through the closed lid's body rather than round its edge.

pc.expect: The kettle's colour and the stove's knobs stay the same.
pc.fail: The kettle changes colour or material; or the stove's burners change position; or the wall behind changes.
